title: Payload — review.withdrawn
$comment: Withdraws the whole chain, whichever link it targets. `reason` is an enum, not free text: this is the one event whose purpose is to retract content, so it must not itself carry permanent user text. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
